dateAssessment: The review uses YAML’s 1748-11-15–1748-11-23 calendar for the reunited-party journey, supported by the spoken November 20 cure and the fourth-day / four-day travel anchors. Session 068’s closing campfire plans (u3214–u3218) and this transcript’s u0333–u0403 establish the same reunited actors and late-night setting. The earlier forest party is Kenzo, Wellby, Delwath and Seeker, as recorded in Session 52; Riswynn’s table speech does not put her in that earlier party. The two opening examinations are separately dated September 14 and September 22 by their vision records and Session 52; their watches are unestablished. The time extraction therefore retains a compatible assessment and an open overall start boundary, rather than extending the November journey by those historical gaps. Hektor’s first-day late-afternoon scry is shown on November 16 following t07; the dated Session 69 record instead lists November 17, pending human reconciliation. Nested November 20 scenes and yesterday’s Commune add no days to the four-day montage.

watches.summary: Earlier forest frame; dated vision records separately assign September 14 and September 22.
Reunited for two or three hours; the DM places the campfire late at night.
Sleep follows the late-night camp; the next waking leads into Kenzo’s dawn ceremony.
Kenzo explicitly sets the curse-breaking ceremony at dawn.
Retrospective first-day scry: Hektor and Vola share the party’s late afternoon; dated note differs.
First thirty-mile camp; Delwath cooks dinner while Riswynn contacts Johar.
The next morning resumes prayer, travel and Sending.
Another next morning brings Johar’s summons to Karnas.
After ninety miles total, Johar reports Karnas’s accusations that evening.
Fourth travel day: the DM corrects midday to mid-afternoon at the scouting camp.
The morning after Raven’s Hold is explicitly dated November twentieth; Havdar’s curse breaks.
During that day’s lunch break, Havdar is seen praying in his tent.
The party makes camp while Havdar and Sura dine; their clocks are explicitly joined.
The Cleansing question is assigned to yesterday; no civil watch is supplied.
Four-day travel ends mid-afternoon; storm study takes half an hour, followed by Clairvoyance and Augury.
The sun sinks toward evening while the party remains camped outside the storm.
